question: Should the ClawSweeper dashboard expose a persistent System / Light / Dark theme control that reuses the docs-site clawsweeper-theme localStorage key?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but a visible dashboard preference and shared stored key are UX/product choices rather than fixes for a documented broken behavior contract.

options.title: Accept dashboard theme control
options.body: Approve the explicit dashboard preference and shared key, but require real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Use a dashboard-specific key
options.body: Keep the selector but ask for a dashboard-only storage key to avoid coupling docs and dashboard theme choices.

options.title: Keep dashboard system-only
options.body: Decline the new preference and continue relying on browser or operating-system color preference for the dashboard.

recommendation.title: Accept dashboard theme control
recommendation.body: Approve the explicit dashboard preference and shared key, but require real browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available owner signal because steipete authored the merged dashboard redesign whose theme behavior this PR changes.
